fields.headline: Families: go to the reunification site at Marston Community College
fields.intro: Marston Police and other agencies are responding to an incident at Marston Central High School. Students are being moved to a safe location, and staff will reunite each student with a parent or guardian.

site.name: Reunification site
site.location: Marston Community College gymnasium, 400 College Drive
site.entrance: Use the north entrance. Parking is in Lot B.

steps: Go directly to the reunification site. Do not go to the school.
Bring a photo ID. Staff will check it and match you with your student.
If you cannot come, call the family information line and name another adult who may pick up your student.
Stay at the site until staff tell you that you may leave with your student.
bring: The name of your student and their grade
pleaseDoNot: Go to the school. Roads around it are closed to everyone.
Call 911 to ask about your student. Use the family information line.
Share unconfirmed reports online. Official updates come from the agencies listed here.
fields.supportNote: Counselors and victim services staff are at the site. You can ask for them at any time.
fields.nextUpdate: 4:00 p.m., on the district website and by text

fields.headline: Family assistance center open at Marston Community College library
fields.intro: Families waiting for information about a loved one can wait here in a private area. Victim services staff will give you updates as soon as they are confirmed, and will tell you first, in person.

site.name: Family assistance center
site.location: Marston Community College library, second building
site.entrance: Staff at the front desk will bring you here.

steps: Check in at the front desk with a photo ID.
Tell the staff member the name of the person you are waiting to hear about.
A victim services staff member will stay with you and share confirmed information.
bring: A phone charger if you have one
pleaseDoNot: Speak with reporters at the entrance; a media area is set up elsewhere.
